title: Inflation: why fixed withdrawals feel tighter every year
objectives: Explain inflation's effect on a withdrawal plan with the ₹50,000 example.
Say why a fixed amount forever fails.
body_md:
Expenses rise every year. At 6% inflation, ₹50,000 of monthly expenses today becomes about ₹90,000 in 10 years. A plan that withdraws a fixed amount forever will feel tighter every year. That is why withdrawal plans build in a yearly increase — reviewed each year, not set and forgotten.

> **Investor takeaway:** At 6% inflation, costs nearly double in about 12 years.
example: ₹50,000 a month today → about ₹90,000 in 10 years at 6% inflation. A fixed ₹50,000 withdrawal buys less every year.
say: A plan that withdraws a fixed amount forever will feel tighter every year.
